chapters.title: Clover Gate
chapters.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a finished landscape illustration for the opening of chapter 1, Clover Gate, in a peaceful children's storybook game. Traditional antique fairy-tale book illustration: fine sepia ink contours and detailed translucent watercolor on warm ivory cotton paper, delicate botanical border, softly feathered painted edges, quiet pastel sage, dusty lilac, butter yellow, pale blue and muted rose. Evoke an old illustrated fairy-tale book opening, not modern animation or flat vector shapes. Scene: a low wooden clover gate opens into a flower-lined country path, a very small snail gatekeeper paints a wooden welcome sign, no legible writing. Two clearly recognizable friends visit: Chochi, a friendly small green dinosaur with a long tail, rounded snout, small arms, three soft back plates and a cream belly; Mochi, a cream white unicorn with four hooves, one small golden horn and a soft lavender mane and tail, wearing a simple saddlebag. Keep animal anatomy clear and consistent; no paws on dinosaur or unicorn. Both peaceful and curious, normal eyes not huge cartoon eyes. Beautiful inviting hand-painted depth with little clover leaves and distant willow hills. Wide composition 3:2, scene readable even at small sizes, generous breathing room, full environment with characters in lower middle. No lettering, no UI, no captions, no logos, no scary elements, no dramatic dark shadows, no violence. Do not include any Disney character or castle. This will be the style and character reference for twenty chapters.
